channel.title: Drinktober 2026 - 31 days. 31 beers. One idiot. on Drinktober 2026
channel.description: Recent content in Drinktober 2026 - 31 days. 31 beers. One idiot. on Drinktober 2026

item.title: Harvesting them on the vine
item.description: Darkness falls over the fields as the Pumpkin Reaper sets to work, gathering the Full Moon Harvest!

item.title: I AM IN THE PUB HELP ME
item.description: The Beercave goats return for the terrifying sequel to Drinktober 2023’s Hell Grazer

item.title: Puttin' on a feast
item.description:
Here at Castle Frankenstein we always like to celebrate Hallowe’en with a big fancy dinner.

Even the creature likes to help out in his own way!

item.title: If you like to gamble…
item.description:
Piercing the veil today as we take a look at what’s happening on the Other Side…

And it’s Lemmy! In his short-shorts! Dancing with the Devil!

item.title: Season of the witch
item.description: Heading into Drinkowe’en week as we get lost in the woods, only to be confronted by Barbie Yaga and her Nightmare Hut!

item.title: Goblin up the snacks
item.description: Winter is coming, the nights are getting darker, and it’s finally time to enthrone myself on the sofa with a big pile of snacks and go full goblin mode!

item.title: It’s an older meme, but it checks out
item.description: Transformed by dark magics into the living avatar of Cyttorak, I have become the unstoppable Juggernaut

item.title: Ribbit!
item.description: A rare sight today, as we catch this magnificent tree frog in its natural environment.

item.title: Oh, it’s that kind of ridge racer!
item.description: I was all excited to get my invitation to take part in the ridge race. I got all my best hiking gear ready, but it seems like I might have got the wrong idea.

item.title: Rollin' rollin' rollin'
item.description: Howdy! Looks like my trip out West has been slightly derailed by a broken down wagon, but luckily I’ve got just the thing to fix it!

item.title: To boldly drink
item.description: Stopping by everyone’s favourite starship bar, but it seems like all they serve is this “synthahol” nonsense. Maybe I should go see if the klingons have anything fit to drink, but first I’m trying to get the hang of the Riker Manoeuvre.

item.title: The crime isss liiiffffe!
item.description:
Is this the end for judge Beerman? Fallen and defeated at the feet of alien superfiend Judge Death, who will save Mega Pub One now?

Find out next prog!

item.title: All Systems Drunk
item.description:
Sigh. No rest for the rogue SecUnit again. All I wanted to do was settle down and watch a few seasons of Sanctuary Moon and here I am, roped into this nonsensical alcohol related dress-up project by another stupid human.

Maybe I should tell him I need to check the perimeter and sneak away…

item.title: Ice Ice Baby
item.description:
What do you get when you cross the ninja turtles with an ice wizard?

Frozen turtles.

item.title: Turtle recall
item.description: Back once again with the ninja rat master, these turtle boys are here to fight crime and eat pizza. And they’ve just finished the pizza.

item.title: Brr! It’s cold in here!
item.description:
Must be some ninjas in the atmosphere!

Stepping out of the frozen shadows, wielding deadly ice powers, the mighty Sub Zero has entered the battle.

item.title: Finish him!
item.description: Electrifying action at the Mortal Kombat tournament as thunder god Raiden delivers a shocking defeat to Scorpion!

item.title: Ain’t no place for a street fightin' man
item.description: Bit of a fighting game theme going on this week, kicking off with an appearance from the Great Demon himself, Akuma!

item.title: Drunken Masters of the Universe
item.description: Beerman, the most powerful man in the pub, returns to Drinktober to battle the evil Skeletor at the gates of Casle Grayskull.

item.title: I’m in Big Trouble now!
item.description:
All I wanted was to take a shortcut through Little China on the way to buy some beers, and now all of a sudden I’m caught up in the evil plans of an undead sorcerer and being attacked by kung fu wizards!

How will I get out of here without ending up in the hell of being cut into little pieces*? It’s all in the reflexes!

*Chinese people have a lot of hells…

item.title: There’s no place like gnome
item.description: Having a nice quiet one today. Chilling in the forest, sitting on a toadstool with my beer. Just living that gnome life.

item.title: I’ll be back. For another pint.
item.description: It can’t be bargained with, it can’t be reasoned with. It doesn’t feel pity or remorse or fear and it absolutely will not stop!… ever… until it has a beer.

item.title: Execute Order 99!
item.description:
Tough times in the Imperial Legions. In an effort to foster a more “friendly” public image, the Emperor has us out selling tasty frozen snacks.

So until Tatooine freezes over, you can call me the Storm Scooper!

item.title: In a world of minor disappointment
item.description:
The “fully immersive Willy Wonka Experience” I’m visiting today turned out to be a bit less impressive than I’d anticipated.

Still, at least I got this beer out of it!

item.title: Come to the pub! We’ll get together! Have some laughs!
item.description:
Looks like Christmas has come early this year, so grab yourself a can and come on in…

Welcome to the party, pal!

item.title: The last pub not corrupted by capitalism!
item.description:
Today we revisit a Drinktober Comics classic issue.

After drinking a can of Nova IPA, Beerman becomes imbued with the awesome power of the Nova Force and sets off to celebrate on a galactic pub crawl.

item.title: Drinky Drinky Beer
item.description: The dwarven bards don’t mention this in their songs but it’s thirsty work Diggin’ a Hole. Lucky for me I’ve got a tasty beer waiting for me when I’m done.

item.title: I came in like a Shrekking Ball
item.description: Day two of Drinktober and I’m getting absolutely Shrekked on this Staggeringly Good Shreker Wrecker

item.title: Welcome to the Beak Parade!
item.description:
When I was
A young bird
My father
Flew me down to the seaside
To steal somebody’s chips

Alright folks, we are back! Drinktober 2026 begins in style as we join the Beak Parade!

item.title: Beer I go again on my own!
item.description:
Ancient spirits of alcohol. Transform this decayed form… into Beerman! The Ever Drinking!

So it’s been a while and there’ve been a few changes around these parts while we were away. First of all, shortly after the thrilling conclusion of Drinktober 2024 that absolute rotter Heidi decided to stop drinking for good. Shocking, right? What kind of a monster puts her own health and wellbeing ahead of my narcissistic need for attention?
